messages:
jordan: Heads up — promo to prod is blocked. deploy-bot reports a partial multipart upload for `redwood-app:canary-2026-03-15` in eu-west-1.

jordan: deploy-bot log: `ERROR: multipart upload aborted after 3/6 parts uploaded (ETag mismatch)`

jordan: full snippet: ```deploy-bot: Promotion failed: aborting; upload_id=3f4a...; last_part=3; error=etag-mismatch
ci-bot: upstream-checksum: 9a1b2c..
storage: received part 3 size=5.2MB md5=98ab... expected=ff12...
```

lia: ugh. is this an infra hiccup or artifact mutating on the way?

sam: likely S3 multipart reordering or a transient proxy. i've seen partial uploads when the uploader retried and a worker restarted.

maria: can we just pin to last-green and promote? we have a change window for 10m. if we wait for reupload it'll push the cut.

ops: pinging storage-team, but manual promote is safest if last-green passed full smoke. what's the tag?

jordan: last-green is `redwood-app:2026-03-14-rc8` (smoke passed 2026-03-15T02:10Z). current canary had a handful of new db migration tests in e2e.

sam: risk tradeoff: pinning unblocks customer-facing rollout but delays the new migration landing. Is it safe to skip this migration now?

maria: the migration is additive (index + null-safe default). it's fine to defer one rollout. we should note in release notes and schedule a follow-up deploy.

lia: alternative: re-run artifact publish job (it's quick-ish) with `CI_RETRY=1` and verify checksum. but that depends on build nodes having the same env. could be another 6-12m.

ops: storage-team (via DM): "we see a 503 spike in eu-west upload gateway between 02:14-02:18Z. some multipart session aborts. recommend retrying upload with --content-md5 verification."

jordan: decision needed: (A) pin to last-green and promote now, (B) retry publish + verify and promote after green, or (C) wait for infra fix and hope upload completes.

sam: +1 for A given the change window. we can schedule a hotfix to re-promote the migration after verifying the artifact.

maria: i'll update release notes and calendar. also open a follow-up ticket to ensure artifact uploader adds stricter md5 checks.

deploy-bot: `promote request denied: artifact verification failed (partial upload).`

jordan: @deploy-bot manual override requested by @maria for this cut. tagging ops for audit.

ops: approved manual promote under change-window. proceeding to pin image to last-green. logging justification in the rollout ticket.

ci-bot: triggering canary using `redwood-app:2026-03-14-rc8` now. smoke pipeline queued (job id 4521).

maria: added note to release-notes draft: "Pin to last-good artifact due to upload integrity error; migration to be re-deployed after artifact re-publish."

jordan: canary smoke passed (job 4521) — all green. promoting to prod. :thumbsup:

sam: open follow-up: INFRA-2319 "Investigate multipart upload ETag mismatches in eu-west gateway" and REL-1428 "Re-publish migration build and verify checksums then re-release migration"

lia: thanks everyone. keeping thread open until infra confirms root cause.

ops: storage-team follow-up (later): "root cause: proxy bumped connection mid-multipart commit. mitigation deployed: proxy will now complete pending commit or return explicit retryable error. rolling to eu-west in 5m."

jordan: noted. closing the immediate release block — will re-run migration publish after window.

maria: closing the release ticket and documenting the pin decision + follow-up tasks. :white_check_mark:
